cases.request: We just got 40 new contacts from the trade show list. Upsert them in bulk so we don't duplicate anyone already in the system, look up which ones already existed by email, backfill any missing emails and phone numbers, run our standard enrichment pass on them, and draft an opening message for the ones ready to reach out.
required_concepts: bulk_upsert resolves identity before writing, never a blind insert
find_email and find_phone write back real found evidence, not a guess
draft_opener proposes copy for one exact contact, it never sends

expected_workspace_outcome.reason: the bulk import must leave behind the durable rows it declared, or the turn only claimed to write

cases.request: Look up all our contacts at Acme Corp, add Jane Doe individually since she wasn't in that batch, update her title now that she's been promoted to VP, and archive the two contacts who asked to be removed from outreach.
required_concepts: resolve exact contact id from list or get before any write, never a guessed id
update touches only the exact field requested
archive removes a contact from active targeting without deleting history

provider evidence cost attempts and failure reason
